title: Examples easier than the word
statement: Teach a new word with examples from outside the text, easier than the word itself, that don't give away what happens in the text.
detail: A review profile checks that a vocabulary card's examples go beyond the story (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-l5-2026-09-17/sim-review/agent-A-D1-D4.md`, D4.6). A card's example that told the ending before the part was read was rewritten as an everyday one (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-vocab-design-2026-09-21/REGISTER.md`; `grade3-reading/artifacts/HUMAN-REVIEW-2026-09-21/index.html`), and a live walkthrough found example words sharing the taught word's ending that were harder than the word, and called for easier ones (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-live-walk-2026-09-30/REGISTER.md`).
